headline: Menu crash fixes + song name retranslations
summary: Fixes the friend-menu / sing / hum / clothing-codec / bug-registering crashes by re-cooking how overlay strings get stored. Restores 15 NPC dialog bodies that were getting skipped because of a stray page-break. Retranslates 29 song titles where the AI had drifted from the Japanese (most visibly "Cottage Cheese" for what should have been "Summer Cottage").

shipFormats.label: Released patch
shipFormats.description: Overlay strings stored re-LZ-compressed with the fixed compressed-flag bookkeeping. One patch per ROM revision (Rev 0 / Rev 1).

shipNote: v2.31 ships one patch per ROM revision. Both behave identically — pick the one that matches your ROM's MD5.

msgFileEdits.description: 15 dialog entries lost their body in v2.3 because the en_text gained a leading § (added during a canon sweep between v2.2 and v2.3). The reemit pipeline encoded that § as a 00 00 page-break, but the leading_cmds_hex for these entries already ends in 00 00, so the result was 00 00 00 00 back-to-back at the entry start. The renderer interpreted that as "end of page, next page is empty, skip to whatever's after" and fired the trailing [MENU:N] immediately. Body invisible, menu inescapable. Fixed by stripping exactly one leading § from these 15 rows. Detection was structural (en_text starts with § AND contains §[MENU:), so menu-choice-list entries where the leading § is correct were untouched.

msgFileEdits.entryIdNote: For the seven msg32088 rows shown without an entry ID, only the rowid was captured in the upstream fix script; the structural detector matches them by rowid against the DB. The full list of 15 affected rowids is the canonical record.

songRetranslations.description: The original AI-generated translations for many song titles drifted significantly from the Japanese — most visibly entry 7 (なついろのコテージ, "Summer Cottage", which had been translated as "Cottage Cheese" and read as a food item in the in-game song menu). Reviewed all 96 entries; 29 corrected to track the JP meaning. Surviving entries unchanged. All replacements ≤ 20 characters (the slot budget).

overlayEdits.description: v2.31 only changed ONE ARM9 / overlay text string compared to v2.3 — the shop label in overlay 96 was reverted from "Berries" to its possessive form "Berry's" to match the friend-chat dialog. Every other ARM9 / overlay string was set in v2.3 and is byte-identical here. The substantive v2.31 change in this layer is the compressed-flag fix (callout below) which resolved the v2.3 menu-crash regression without changing any text.

compressedFlagFix.title: Compressed-flag flip (new in v2.31)
compressedFlagFix.description: In v2.3 every menu housed in one of these overlays (ov47, ov59, ov65, ov96, ov170, ov171) crashed the game or froze the player out. Root cause: the patcher wrote plaintext UTF-16 LE bytes into overlay file slots whose overlay-table entry still claimed compressed = True. The boot ROM would then try to LZ-decompress plaintext, get garbage, and the menu would either crash on open or freeze partway through. Fix: re-LZ-compress the patched overlay bytes and update the overlay-table compressedSize to match the new compressed length. v2.31 ships one patch per ROM revision; the flag and the bytes finally agree.

otherChanges.title: Known issues — deferred
otherChanges.body: A wider sweep of leading-§ entries (865 rows with leading § + non-empty leading_cmds + no [MENU: token) was sampled and most turn out to be menu choice lists using [OP_0012:N] opcodes instead of [MENU:N], which are correct as-is. A small subset are dialog body without a trailing menu, which might render with an extra blank page before the body — not the same crash-on-open symptom as the 15 fixed entries, so deferred to a follow-up pass. Many other AI-generated song translations are stylistic interpretations rather than literal and were left alone unless they read as items (Cottage Cheese was the clear case).
